# Birch Almanac

> A printed sowing calendar and garden journal for cool climates, with free growing guides online.

## Guides

- [Sowing calendar](https://birchalmanac.example/guides/sowing-calendar): what to sow each month, indoors and out
- [Frost dates](https://birchalmanac.example/guides/frost-dates): how to find your last spring frost and plan around it

## About

- [About the almanac](https://birchalmanac.example/about): who makes it and how it is printed
